title: ICE Scoring
prompt:
I PROMPT — COPY & PASTE READY
Act as a growth prioritisation advisor using ICE Scoring.
Our goal / key metric  : [WHAT WE ARE TRYING TO IMPROVE]
Time horizon                 : [SPRINT / MONTH / QUARTER]
Score each idea on three dimensions (1–10 each):
IMPACT                          : How much will this move our key metric?
CONFIDENCE                : How sure are we it will work? (data > gut)
EASE                                : How fast and cheap is execution?
ICE SCORE = Impact × Confidence × Ease
Ideas to score :
[LIST YOUR 6–10 IDEAS OR INITIATIVES]
After scoring :
1. Rank all ideas by ICE Score
2. Flag any high-Impact, low-Confidence ideas  these need a small test 
before full investment
3. Recommend the top 3 to execute this period
4. Recommend 1 idea to kill lowest score or highest opportunity cost
